netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_B1 n1 B1_am 0
V_B1 B1_int 0 PWL(0 0 4e-08 1.5)
R_B1_in B1_am B1_int 0.1
vam_T1 n1 T1_am 0
vam_T1_p1 n2 T1_p1 0
vam_T1_p2 n3 T1_p2 0
vam_T1_p3 n4 T1_p3 0
L_T1p T1_am T1_pl 1e-05
R_T1_pw T1_pl T1_p1 0.1
L_T1s T1_p2 T1_sl 1e-05
R_T1_sw T1_sl T1_p3 0.1
K_T1 L_T1p L_T1s 0.99
vam_Q1 n2 Q1_am 0
vam_Q1_p0 n3 Q1_p0 0
vam_Q1_p2 0 Q1_p2 0
Q_Q1 Q1_am Q1_p0 Q1_p2 2N3904
vam_R1 n1 R1_am 0
R_R1 R1_am n4 1000
vam_LED1 n2 LED1_am 0
D_LED1 LED1_am n1 LED_red
.model 2N3904 NPN(IS=6.734f XTI=3 EG=1.11 VAF=74.03 BF=416.4 NE=1.259 ISE=6.734f IKF=66.78m XTB=1.5 BR=.7371 NC=2 ISC=0 IKR=0 RC=1 CJC=3.638p MJC=.3085 VJC=.75 FC=.5 CJE=4.493p MJE=.2593 VJE=.75 TR=239.5n TF=301.2p ITF=.4 VTF=4 XTF=2 RB=10)
.model LED_red D(IS=3.2850e-17 N=2.0 RS=2.0 EG=2.300 XTI=3 BV=5 IBV=10u CJO=20p TT=10n)
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 4e-08 5e-05 1e-05 4e-08
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) v(n3) v(n4) i(vam_b1) i(vam_t1) i(vam_q1) i(vam_r1) i(vam_led1) i(vam_t1_p1) i(vam_t1_p2) i(vam_t1_p3) i(vam_q1_p0) i(vam_q1_p2)
quit
.endc
.end
